request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Redraw him as a dim-witted ogre. Skin: pale jade green, colour #a3d1b5, shaded #6aa98a. Face: sleepy half-closed eyes, a big round nose, a vacant open smile with one big cream tooth sticking up. The tin cap becomes a small light grey tin bucket worn upside down as a hat. Remove the shield: enormous bare pale jade shoulders with two sand-buff straps, and the fat nail-studded head of a dark brown wooden club beside his head. Keep the thick black outline and art style, transparent background.
